title: Planning puts every reader of a symbol a goal changes into the item's touches, so workers do not stop or widen touches themselves
goal: SP-befc6yqr: ST-qgnjxiol stopped on the backlog.py registration and bl_land/bl_cli readers outside its touches (a resume round trip), and BG-uoexdu6y's worker widened its own touches by six bl_ modules that import the constants it changed. Planning (kb-sprint plan step 2, /kb-backlog bug) runs backlog.py referrers on each symbol or constant an item's goal changes and on a new subcommand's facade registration, and adds the files it lists to touches before the claim. Also: a removed or renamed command flag is run through referrers as a term and puts each file that prints or documents it in touches (SP-ktup3cha: ST-juoeq36g's touches lacked bl_check.py, bl_plan.py, bl_land.py and backlog.py, whose messages named set --add); a task adding a new _tools/ module names the docs map's csv, and one adding a flag names its command facade (such as _tools/benchmarks.py) and the readers it calls (SP-hm4qgf3t: ST-4y2kdowd, ST-ohz5si2o); an item that moves the figures of the benchmarks results file or the report code has README.md in its touches, since report --check reads README's numbers (SP-x7ger6vu: ST-qiep6y7i).

r = lambda p: open(p, encoding='utf-8').read()
sp, bk, doc = r('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md'), r('.claude/skills/kb-backlog/SKILL.md'), r('kb/_self/backlog.md')

       'sprint plan names the benchmarks results file and README.md': 'benchmarks.csv' in sp and 'README.md' in sp,
       'kb-backlog names a new tool module': 'adding a new tool module' in bk,
       'backlog.md Sprints names both': 'removed or renamed flag' in doc and 'adding a new `_tools/` module' in doc}
print(got)
sys.exit(0 if all(got.values()) else 1)
